businesses.business: electrical power distribution and control equipment manufacturing

offering_description.value: Designs, engineers and manufactures custom electrical power distribution, control and monitoring equipment such as switchgear and power control rooms. Sells mainly to industrial, utility and transit customers, and also provides lifecycle services and maintenance.

primary_products.value: switchgear; power control rooms (e-houses); motor control centers; bus duct; traction power substations

primary_services.value: equipment maintenance and repair; field service; retrofits and upgrades; replacement parts; remote monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas, petrochemical, utilities, pulp and paper, mining and commercial industrial customers; B2G: public transit agencies and municipal utilities

end_markets.value: oil and gas; petrochemical; electric utilities; public transit and rail; commercial and industrial

revenue_model.value: project or contract: custom-engineered power equipment systems built to customer order; service fees: maintenance, repair, retrofit and field services; product sales: replacement parts and standard equipment
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds engineered switchgear and enclosures from purchased components, sold to industrial, utility and transit customers; service provider: services installed power equipment for existing customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada primarily, with some international projects

specialization.value: related lines: switchgear, power control rooms, bus systems, traction power and related services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales to end users and engineering contractors; agents / brokers: sales representatives in some regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: electrical equipment safety standards (UL, IEEE, NEMA), hazardous location and export rules
